releases.body: Agent now actually completes tasks: hardening instruction on every run, intent-only replies ("Let me read that file first") are detected and retried once with a nudge, and fallback text is accurate for each failure mode.

## What's fixed
- **Misleading fallback text**: the 'agent timed out' note was baked into the general inability reply and showed up even when no agent had run (short-chat messages go direct to the local model). It now appears **only** in the task fallback, i.e. only when the opencode agent genuinely ran and hit the timeout.
- **Hardened direct-Qwen call**: history is sanitized before sending (valid roles + non-empty content, prompt capped below the context window) to prevent the intermittent HTTP 400; HTTP error bodies are now logged so any future failure is instantly diagnosable; transient errors (429/5xx) retry once.
- **Agent timeout raised** from 180s to 300s (still env-overridable via OPENCODE_TIMEOUT_MS) so real tasks on the local 9B model have room to finish.

## Tested
- Direct-Qwen fast path (hello / time question / demo message) — verified no misleading 'timed out' text
- Agentic fallback chain (task → agent timeout → task fallback)
- Slash commands (/help)
- Bot restarted via launchd, single process, polling healthy

releases.name: v1.0.9 — conversation history persistence
releases.body:
## v1.0.9 — Conversation history persistence

Control OpenCode from your phone via Telegram: 70+ slash commands, run shell commands, approve permissions, manage sessions, and chat with your local AI assistant.

### Highlights (1.0.0 → 1.0.9)
- **Persist conversation history across bot restarts** (v1.0.9)
- Fix `TASK_RE` stem matching; drop `find`/`locate` shell false positives (v1.0.8)
- Catch "attempt to" fake promises; stop "go ahead" from routing to the `go` binary (v1.0.7)
- Inspection routing + fake-action fallback filter (v1.0.6)
- Route unknown binaries; drop `say` from shell whitelist (v1.0.5)
- 70+ slash commands, session management, shell execution, permission approvals

### Install
```bash
npm i -g gutchapa-opencode-telegram
```

### Docs
https://github.com/gutchapa/opencode-telegram#readme
